Container.Name: KeyHunter
Container.Overview: Private Xbox wishlist that compares the best key valid in your country with the cheapest region worldwide. IGDB search, Eneba and Driffle offers, price history and price alerts via ntfy, Telegram, Discord, e-mail, Gotify, Pushover or webhook. Pull the linux/amd64 image from GitHub Container Registry. See the repository installation guide.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: HTTP for a private LAN IP. For HTTPS use a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Dedicated local appdata directory. The template prepares the data directory at startup. SQLite must not use SMB/NFS.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Optional protected config directory containing a legacy ntfy.env (channels are set up in the app since 0.9.0). Restrict file access to the container UID. Never paste secrets into template variables.

Config.Name: ntfy configuration file
Config.Description: Optional owner-readable file containing NTFY_URL and NTFY_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Daily jobs per shop
Config.Description: Default daily cap per shop (1-2000), spread evenly over the UTC day. Every catalog search page and regional product is a separate persistent job. A value set in the app under Settings / Key-Shops overrides this default for that shop; service intervals are set there too.

Config.Name: Web origin (optional)
Config.Description: Leave blank to use the browser host. Set a complete HTTP(S) URL to pin one origin.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxy (optional)
Config.Description: IP or CIDR range of your reverse proxy, comma-separated. Only then the sign-in throttle counts the client address from X-Forwarded-For; otherwise every request through the proxy counts as one source.

Config.Name: Allow LAN HTTP
Config.Description: Allows sign-in and changes over HTTP on private IP addresses when no origin is pinned. Set false for HTTPS only.
